# MuscleDesk

> MuscleDesk is a complete gym management SaaS for Indian gym owners — member management, attendance (QR & fingerprint), payments, plans, leads, and a self-service member portal.

MuscleDesk is an authenticated application; most surfaces are gated behind owner, staff, or member login. The pages below are public entry points.

## Pages

- [Home](/): MuscleDesk product overview and gym-owner sign-in entry point.
- [MuscleDesk vs Gymdesk](/compare/muscledesk-vs-gymdesk): Honest comparison of MuscleDesk and Gymdesk for Indian gym owners — pricing, member portal, attendance, WhatsApp follow-ups, and market fit.
- [Owner / Staff Login](/login): Sign in for gym owners and staff to access the management dashboard.
- [Member Login](/member/login): PIN-based sign-in for gym members to access their personal portal.
